grade.basis: Independent whole-score reading of all eight pages. Viola 1 sets the ceiling, closely matched by viola 2: sustained exposed upper-register playing, alto/treble clef changes, chromatic slurred runs and brief quintuplet thirty-second-note flourishes in the Andante marcato (quarter = 80, notably mm. 29 and 41). The Adagio fluido (quarter = 56) surrounds this with long upper notes and precisely displaced sixteenth-rest entries; short tied and dotted figures, changing bow articulation, accelerando and metric transitions require secure subdivision and controlled bow distribution. Lower parts also receive short chromatic figures and register changes, but there is no sustained double-stop or virtuoso passagework burden. Pre-diploma is an advisory estimate, approximately within one level; the eight-player scoring itself receives no automatic uplift.

findings.finding: Complete eight-page score inspected locally: Marble Fountain by Jonathan Crosmer, for eight violas, copyright 2016, dedicated to Clark Potter. Adagio fluido outer sections and an Andante marcato middle section; chromatic writing without a prevailing key signature makes a binary major/minor tag uncertain.
